propositions: errored sides of paired runs are incorrectly counted as decision flips because the flip comprehension at parity.py:107 lacks an errored guard, causing transient infrastructure errors to be misattributed as model-quality regressions

a single errored pair with synthetic decision='dropped' causes decision_flips to increment and fails parity criterion (b) when criterion (d) already gates error rate separately, double-counting the same event
the gating report cannot distinguish fabricated flips caused by errors from real model-verdict disagreements because errored_pairs is not surfaced as a separate metric
errored=True with valid=True produces a silent fabricated flip with no corroborating signal when checked against the decision vocabulary
the fix adds an errored guard to decision_flips computation reading a.errored or b.errored, excludes errored pairs from flip count, and surfaces errored_pairs in metrics and failure strings
